bootstrap.method: circular moving-block, percentile interval, paired draws

c11_reproduction.note: C12 computes no new dispatch and no new forecast. Every interval it reports is an interval around a number C11 committed, so the point estimates must agree to numerical precision or the interval is about something else.

1.note: The fifteen rows are not independent — they share zones, arms and days — which is exactly why the correlation is recomputed inside each replicate rather than bootstrapped over the rows.
